tier1.text: Each hip bone is the attachment point for a lower limb. Each adult hip bone forms from three bones that fuse together in the late teenage years. These three parts meet to form the acetabulum, a deep cup that is part of the hip joint. The ischium, the rear and lower part of each hip bone, supports the body when you sit.

sentences.text: Each hip bone is the attachment point for a lower limb.

quotes.quote: The pelvic girdle (hip girdle) is formed by a single bone, the hip bone or coxal bone (coxal = “hip”), which serves as the attachment point for each lower limb.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Each adult hip bone forms from three bones that fuse together in the late teenage years.

quotes.quote: Each adult hip bone is formed by three separate bones that fuse together during the late teenage years.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: These three parts meet to form the acetabulum, a deep cup that is part of the hip joint.

quotes.quote: The three areas of each hip bone, the ilium, pubis, and ischium, converge centrally to form a deep, cup-shaped cavity called the acetabulum. This is located on the lateral side of the hip bone and is part of the hip joint.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The ischium, the rear and lower part of each hip bone, supports the body when you sit.

quotes.quote: The ischium forms the posteroinferior region of each hip bone. It supports the body when sitting.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
